Result: -- Upgrades: pure data for the dropper / ore tier / speed / cash multiplier tree.
-- No requires, no side effects. Returns { list = {...}, byId = {...}, ores = {...}, starterCash = n }.
--
-- This table is the SINGLE source of truth for upgrade prices. Shop cards, world pads, the
-- server purchase check, the tutorial text and the HUD "Next:" hint must all read cost from here.
-- Dropper 2 = 10 and Speed 1 (Fast Belt) = 22, matching the design doc, Config.STARTING_CASH (10)
-- and the tutorial text ("the pad costs $10").
--
-- BUDGET MATH
--   The first cube (Bronze) is worth 5 cash. The player starts with 10 cash, so the first buy
--   (Dropper 2, 10 cash) is affordable immediately after claiming a plot. After that, income is
--   5 cash/s (2 cubes per 2 s cycle x 5 cash), so every following purchase lands 4-24 s apart.
--   Total cost of all 10 upgrades:
--     10 + 22 + 60 + 150 + 300 + 500 + 800 + 1300 + 2200 + 4000 = 9342 cash
--   Income after each milestone (cubes per 2 s cycle x ore value x cash multiplier, per second),
--   and the approximate wait for the NEXT purchase at that income:
--     base                        1 x 5  x 1.0 / 2 =   2.5 /s   (Dropper 2 affordable immediately)
--     dropper2                    2 x 5  x 1.0 / 2 =   5   /s   (Speed 1, 22  -> ~4 s)
--     speed1                                           5   /s   (Silver, 60   -> ~8 s)
--     tier_silver                 2 x 12 x 1.0 / 2 =  12   /s   (Dropper 3, 150 -> ~12 s)
--     dropper3                    3 x 12 x 1.0 / 2 =  18   /s   (Cash x1.5, 300 -> ~17 s)
--     mult1 (x1.5)                3 x 12 x 1.5 / 2 =  27   /s   (Gold, 500 -> ~18 s)
--     tier_gold                   3 x 30 x 1.5 / 2 =  67.5 /s   (Speed 2, 800 -> ~12 s)
--     speed2                                          67.5 /s   (Dropper 4, 1300 -> ~19 s)
--     dropper4                    4 x 30 x 1.5 / 2 =  90   /s   (Cash x2, 2200 -> ~24 s)
--     mult2 (x2)                  4 x 30 x 2.0 / 2 = 120   /s   (Diamond, 4000 -> ~33 s)
--     tier_diamond                4 x 75 x 2.0 / 2 = 300   /s
--   (speed upgrades only shorten the trip to the collector.)
--
-- Effect shapes:
--   { kind = "dropper",  slots = n }   total active dropper slots after purchase
--   { kind = "tier",     tier = n }    ore tier every dropper spits out (index into ores)
--   { kind = "speed",    mult = x }    conveyor speed multiplier
--   { kind = "cashMult", mult = x }    collector cash multiplier
--
-- Optional presentation fields (read by the client for the purchase celebration):
--   label  = short headline string
--   popup  = RewardPopup text (shown with Win sting, shockwave ring and FOV punch for ore tiers)
--   color  = Color3 for the shockwave ring / popup (ore tiers)
--
-- Every `requires` points at an existing id, so pads reveal progressively.

local list = {
	{ id = "dropper2", name = "Dropper 2", cost = 10, requires = nil, effect = { kind = "dropper", slots = 2 } },
	{ id = "speed1", name = "Speed 1", cost = 22, requires = "dropper2", effect = { kind = "speed", mult = 1.5 } },
	{
		id = "tier_silver",
		name = "Silver Ore",
		cost = 60,
		requires = "dropper2",
		effect = { kind = "tier", tier = 2 },
		label = "Silver Ore",
		popup = "SILVER ORE! $12 per cube",
		color = Color3.fromRGB(205, 210, 220),
	},
	{ id = "dropper3", name = "Dropper 3", cost = 150, requires = "dropper2", effect = { kind = "dropper", slots = 3 } },
	{ id = "mult1", name = "Cash x1.5", cost = 300, requires = "tier_silver", effect = { kind = "cashMult", mult = 1.5 } },
	{
		id = "tier_gold",
		name = "Gold Ore",
		cost = 500,
		requires = "tier_silver",
		effect = { kind = "tier", tier = 3 },
		label = "Gold Ore",
		popup = "GOLD ORE! $30 per cube",
		color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40),
	},
	{ id = "speed2", name = "Speed 2", cost = 800, requires = "speed1", effect = { kind = "speed", mult = 2 } },
	{ id = "dropper4", name = "Dropper 4", cost = 1300, requires = "dropper3", effect = { kind = "dropper", slots = 4 } },
	{ id = "mult2", name = "Cash x2", cost = 2200, requires = "mult1", effect = { kind = "cashMult", mult = 2 } },
	{
		id = "tier_diamond",
		name = "Diamond Ore",
		cost = 4000,
		requires = "tier_gold",
		effect = { kind = "tier", tier = 4 },
		label = "Diamond Ore",
		popup = "DIAMOND ORE! $75 per cube",
		color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 235, 255),
	},
}

-- Indexed by tier.
local ores = {
	{ name = "Bronze", value = 5, color = Color3.fromRGB(205, 127, 50), material = Enum.Material.Metal, sparkles = false },
	{ name = "Silver", value = 12, color = Color3.fromRGB(205, 210, 220), material = Enum.Material.Metal, sparkles = false },
	{ name = "Gold", value = 30, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40), material = Enum.Material.Foil, sparkles = false },
	{ name = "Diamond", value = 75, color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 235, 255), material = Enum.Material.Glass, sparkles = true },
}

local byId = {}
for _, upgrade in ipairs(list) do
	byId[upgrade.id] = upgrade
end

-- Sanity check: every requirement must reference an existing upgrade id.
for _, upgrade in ipairs(list) do
	if upgrade.requires ~= nil and byId[upgrade.requires] == nil then
		warn("[Upgrades] " .. upgrade.id .. " requires unknown id " .. tostring(upgrade.requires))
	end
end

return {
	list = list,
	byId = byId,
	ores = ores,
	-- Starter grant: matches Config.STARTING_CASH so the first upgrade (Dropper 2, 10) is affordable immediately.
	starterCash = 10,
}

-- ShopUi.client: client-only shop panel (SHOP button + upgrade cards). Sends intent only.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local UiTheme = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("UiTheme"))
local Upgrades = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Upgrades"))

local ShopFx = nil
do
	local fxModule = script.Parent:WaitForChild("ShopFx", 10)
	if fxModule then
		local okFx, mod = pcall(require, fxModule)
		if okFx then
			ShopFx = mod
		end
	end
	if not ShopFx then
		warn("[ShopUi] ShopFx missing; using no-op effects")
		ShopFx = {
			openPanel = function(p)
				p.Visible = true
				local sc = p:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
				if sc then
					sc.Scale = 0
					TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
				end
			end,
			buySuccess = function() end,
			buyFail = function() end,
		}
	end
end
local pendingBuy = nil

local buyRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BuyUpgrade", 10)
local syncRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ShopSync", 10)
if not buyRemote or not syncRemote then
	warn("[ShopUi] shop remotes missing; shop disabled")
	return
end

local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local ownedSet = {}
local cash = 0
local cards = {}
local lastBuy = 0

-- Effect text built from the exact effect fields in Upgrades
local function effectText(u)
	local e = u.effect
	if type(e) ~= "table" then
		return ""
	end
	if e.kind == "dropper" then
		return "Droppers: " .. tostring(e.slots)
	elseif e.kind == "tier" then
		local ore = Upgrades.ores[e.tier]
		if ore then
			return ore.name .. " ore, $" .. tostring(ore.value) .. " each"
		end
		return "Ore tier " .. tostring(e.tier)
	elseif e.kind == "speed" then
		return "Conveyor speed x" .. tostring(e.mult)
	elseif e.kind == "cashMult" then
		return "Cash payout x" .. tostring(e.mult)
	end
	return tostring(e.kind)
end

local function swatchColor(u)
	local e = u.effect
	if type(e) == "table" then
		if e.kind == "tier" and Upgrades.ores[e.tier] then
			return Upgrades.ores[e.tier].color
		elseif e.kind == "dropper" then
			return UiTheme.info
		elseif e.kind == "speed" then
			return UiTheme.good
		end
	end
	return UiTheme.accent
end

	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Name = name
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	l.Size = size
	l.Font = UiTheme.font
	l.TextScaled = true

	cap.MinTextSize = 10

	cap.Parent = l

local function refresh()
	for _, c in ipairs(cards) do
		local u = c.upgrade
		local owned = ownedSet[u.id] == true
		local reqName = nil
		if u.requires and not ownedSet[u.requires] then
			local req = Upgrades.byId[u.requires]
			reqName = req and req.name or tostring(u.requires)
		end
		local dimmed = (not owned) and cash < u.cost
		c.frame.BackgroundTransparency = dimmed and 0.45 or 0
		c.name.TextColor3 = dimmed and UiTheme.locked or UiTheme.text
		c.effect.TextColor3 = dimmed and UiTheme.locked or UiTheme.text
		c.cost.TextColor3 = dimmed and UiTheme.locked or UiTheme.text
		c.swatch.BackgroundTransparency = dimmed and 0.5 or 0
		c.cost.Text = "$" .. tostring(u.cost)
		local b = c.button
		if owned then
			b.Text = "Owned"
			b.BackgroundColor3 = UiTheme.dim
			b.AutoButtonColor = false
			b.Active = false
		elseif reqName then
			b.Text = "Locked (needs " .. reqName .. ")"
			b.BackgroundColor3 = UiTheme.locked
			b.AutoButtonColor = false
			b.Active = false
		else
			b.Text = "Buy"
			b.BackgroundColor3 = dimmed and UiTheme.dim or UiTheme.good
			b.AutoButtonColor = true
			b.Active = true
		end
		b.TextWrapped = true
	end
end

local function tryBuy(card)
	local u = card.upgrade
	if ownedSet[u.id] then
		return
	end
	if u.requires and not ownedSet[u.requires] then
		return
	end
	if os.clock() - lastBuy < 0.4 then
		return
	end
	if cash < u.cost then
		local b = card.button
		b.BackgroundColor3 = UiTheme.bad
		task.delay(0.25, refresh)
		ShopFx.buyFail(card.frame)
		return
	end
	lastBuy = os.clock()
	local token = { card = card }
	pendingBuy = token
	buyRemote:FireServer(u.id)
	task.delay(2, function()
		if pendingBuy == token then
			pendingBuy = nil
			ShopFx.buyFail(card.frame)
		end
	end)
end
